topic: Dance/Movement therapy for children and adolescents with cancer

sources.title: Dance/Movement therapy for children and adolescents with cancer

findings.finding: Dance and movement therapy serves as an innovative approach addressing comprehensive health and psychosocial issues.
findings.quote: Dance/movement therapy is introduced as a holistic approach to children's health issues, incorporating an array of medical, psychological, social, and spiritual issues.

findings.finding: The modality utilizes nonverbal communication within assessment and treatment strategies.
findings.quote: Dance/movement therapy, with its unique emphasis on nonverbal communication in assessment and treatment, is presented as an innovative therapeutic approach to address the comprehensive needs of children and adolescents with cancer.

findings.finding: Interventions are connected to developmental processes and psychological adjustment models.
findings.quote: Dance/movement therapy assessment and intervention strategies are discussed in the context of cognitive, emotional, and social developmental processes, as well as models of stress and psychological adjustment in pediatric cancer.

principle: Dance and movement interventions integrate cognitive, emotional, and social processes to support coping and holistic care in pediatric populations.
for_the_teacher: Incorporate nonverbal communication cues to support emotional expression and holistic wellbeing during movement exercises.
